name: locust-azure-load-testing
description: Use when creating or running parameterized Locust scenarios through Azure Load Testing against the Vision Search websites or API.

# Locust and Azure Load Testing

Keep site-load and API-search scenarios separable. Parameterize target URLs, user count, spawn rate, duration, request mix, fixture selection, and optional headers. Cover page loads, text queries, image URL queries, multipart uploads, filters/facets, and crop-search requests. Store reproducible test configuration and pass/fail thresholds, but never commit credentials or SAS URLs. Report latency, throughput, errors, and the tested deployment configuration.
